title: Job Search Guide
dek: What entry-level roles in my target fields ask for, where the gaps are, and which chapters close them. Built from about 30 real postings read in October 2026.
intro: This page turns postings into a study plan. Each track lists the roles I am aiming at, what the postings keep asking for, and where to learn it in this library. The gaps are ranked by how many postings they blocked.
No application details are kept here. This page is only about skills.

tracks.title: Lab, QC and production chemistry
asks: Good manufacturing and documentation practice: cGMP, GDP, ALCOA+, SOPs, batch records, deviations.
Aseptic technique, media and buffer preparation, pH and osmolality, lab calculations (molarity, dilutions).
HPLC and UPLC for peptides and biologics: reversed-phase, size-exclusion, ion-exchange, capillary electrophoresis, system suitability.
Cell culture and molecular biology: PCR, qPCR, gels, cloning, ELISA.
Accurate records, careful work, and 0 to 2 years of lab experience.

study.label: Assay Data: Calibration, Replicates and QC

tracks.coming: Biotech Lab and Quality book (GMP, bench skills, biologics methods), planned.

tracks.title: Data and machine learning for biotech and medtech
asks: Python with pandas and plots, applied to instrument and plate-reader exports.
SQL, including joins, aggregation and window functions.
Statistics for lab decisions: confidence intervals, t-tests, method comparison.
Dashboards and reporting (Power BI, Tableau) and clean documentation.
Scikit-learn on assay data; for regulated work, traceability and validation.

study.label: Python and pandas for Lab Data
Assay Data: Calibration, Replicates and QC

tracks.coming: Statistics for lab decisions, machine learning on assay data and intro bioinformatics chapters, planned.

tracks.title: AI training and evaluation
asks: Domain knowledge to check content for accuracy, and clear written reasoning for each judgment.
Following evaluation guidelines exactly and meeting turnaround targets.
Comfort with chatbots and AI tools. Prior annotation experience helps but is often not required.
Many of the best-paid versions are for current students or advanced degrees.

study.label: Assay Data: reporting and data integrity

tracks.title: Game development and design
asks: Experience in the studio's engine, often Unreal with Blueprints and the Gameplay Ability System.
Level design systems and basic multiplayer replication.
Clear written design documents and playtest feedback.
tracks.coming: Unreal Engine basics and a Godot-to-Unreal comparison, planned.

gaps.title: Years of experience
gaps.detail: Almost every posting labeled entry level asked for 1 to 3 years. The fix is projects with real data, a short hands-on lab course, and listing projects as experience.

gaps.title: GMP and QC lab practice
gaps.detail: The most common lab blocker: documentation rules, SOPs, deviations and data integrity.

gaps.title: Bench biology
gaps.detail: Aseptic technique, cell culture, media preparation, PCR and ELISA.

gaps.title: The reporting stack
gaps.detail: Advanced SQL, Power BI and DAX, Tableau, and Jira for requirements.

gaps.title: Biotech data and machine learning
gaps.detail: Instrument data, bioinformatics, and scikit-learn on lab data.

gaps.title: Game engine experience
gaps.detail: Unreal Engine and a playable portfolio in it.

gaps.title: Not fixable by study
gaps.detail: Current-student status and security clearances rule out some internships. Skip those postings and look for early-career versions.

ready: Explain how a calibration curve turns a signal into a concentration, and when a result is out of range.
Calculate CV% and percent recovery from replicates and say what an acceptable value depends on.
Read an instrument export in Python, clean it, and plot it with labeled axes and error bars.
Say what happens when a control fails: investigate and document, never delete.
Describe a project of your own, what you built, what you measured, and what you would do next.
